scope: UART0 TX nominal-rate interoperability on exact L48 PIN_10 / Pico GP4 path. Firmware used ag32_uart_ref_hz_measured() and the Pico PIO UART receiver was independently configured to each requested rate; it decoded 64/64 bytes with the exact repeating pattern at 9600, 38400, and 115200 baud. This supersedes the old ~560-baud result for firmware that incorrectly passed ag32_pbus_hz(248000000). It qualifies TX and these three nominal rates in the inherited HSI state, not sub-percent absolute frequency accuracy, RX, flow control, UART1-4, another oscillator/board, or dynamic clock switching. SRAM only; no flash writes; board reset after the matrix.
